quadrant.name: Goldilocks
quadrant.note: one axis is within +/-0.25 of zero, so the quadrant is a lean, not a call

flags.text: 30y at or above 5.25% (or +25bp in a month) with elevated bond vol: 2023 and 1994-style duration stress
The Fed has raised its target within six months and the 2y prices more: 1994, 2004, 2015 and 2022 all began this way
Oil up 25%+ in three months: 1973, 1979, 1990, 2008 and 2022 all featured one

signals.name: 10-year real yield
signals.read: real 10y 2.76% (+53bp 3m); highest discount rate on long-duration cash flows since 2007 when above 2.5

signals.name: 30-year yield and its momentum
signals.rule: >=5.25 or +25bp in 1m -2; >=4.75 or +15bp -1; <4.25 and falling +1; else 0
signals.read: 30y 5.40% (+17bp 1m); long-end supply and term premium set the equity discount rate

signals.name: 10-year term premium
signals.read: term premium 0.96% (+21bp 3m): investors demanding pay for duration risk (fiscal, inflation uncertainty)

signals.name: Curve move (2y vs 10y over 1m)
signals.rule: bear steepening or bear flattening -1; bull flattening +1; bull steepening 0 (easing, but often recession onset); moves under 5bp 0

signals.name: MOVE index (Treasury implied vol)
signals.read: MOVE 105 (+33 1m); bond vol drives MBS convexity hedging, dealer balance sheets and equity multiples

signals.name: Stock-bond correlation (60d SPY vs TLT)
signals.rule: >+0.3 -1 (bonds do not hedge: inflation/term-premium regime, 1970s and 2022 style); <-0.2 +1 (bonds hedge); else 0

signals.name: Priced Fed path (2-year minus effective fed funds)
signals.rule: bp: >=+50 -2 (a hiking cycle priced); +15..+50 -1; -50..+15 0; <-50 +1 (cuts priced; check growth before cheering)
signals.read: 2y 4.85% vs fed funds 3.88%: +97bp (+36bp 1m); the 2y is the market's two-year Fed forecast

signals.name: Real policy rate (fed funds minus core PCE y/y)
High-yield OAS level
signals.rule: <3.0 +1; 3.0-4.0 0; 4.0-5.5 -1; >=5.5 -2 (tight spreads are benign but leave no cushion)

signals.name: CCC minus HY OAS (the weak tail)
signals.rule: gap percentile over 5y: >=85 -1 (weakest borrowers cracking under high rates while the index looks calm); <=30 +1; else 0

signals.name: Senior loan officers: net % tightening C&I
signals.rule: >=40 -2; 20-40 -1; 0-20 0; <0 +1 (bank credit supply leads defaults by 2-4 quarters)

signals.name: VIX level
signals.rule: <20 +1; 20-25 0; 25-30 -1; >=30 -2 (below 13 is complacency; noted, not scored against)

signals.name: Net Fed liquidity (balance sheet - TGA - RRP)
Funding pressure (SOFR minus IORB, 5-day avg)
signals.rule: bp: >=+10 -2; +3..+10 -1; else 0 (repo above the Fed's floor rate means reserves are getting scarce: Sept 2019)

signals.name: Dollar 3-month change (DXY, else broad index)
signals.rule: %: >=+5 -2; +2..+5 -1; -2..+2 0; <-2 +1 (a falling dollar loosens global financial conditions)

signals.name: Yen carry unwind (USD/JPY 1m change)
signals.rule: %: <=-5 -2; -5..-3 -1; else 0 (a fast yen rally forces deleveraging of funded risk: Aug 2024)

signals.name: Re-steepening after inversion (10y-3m)
signals.rule: -1 when 10y-3m was below -0.5 within 24 months and is now above 0: historically the window when recessions start; else 0

signals.name: Headline CPI momentum (3m annualised vs y/y)
Oil shock gauge (WTI 3m change and level)
Mortgage rate minus 10-year (MBS spread proxy)
signals.rule: bp: <170 +1; 170-250 0; 250-300 -1; >=300 -2 (wide = MBS buyers absent, rate vol high, Fed running off MBS)

signals.name: Building permits, 3m average y/y
signals.rule: %: <=-10 -1; >=+5 +1; else 0 (permits lead starts, employment and builder margins)

signals.name: Case-Shiller national y/y
signals.rule: %: <0 -1 (collateral values falling: bank, MBS and consumer-wealth channel); >=0 0

signals.name: Agency MBS vs Treasuries (MBB / IEF, 3m)
signals.rule: %: >=+1 +1; <=-1 -1; else 0 (MBS underperforming = spread widening, convexity selling)

signals.name: S&P 500 trend (50d, 200d)
signals.rule: above 200d with 50>200 +1; above 200d, 50<200 0; below 200d -1; below with 50<200 and 200d falling -2

signals.name: Equal weight vs cap weight (RSP / SPY, 3m)
High beta vs low vol (SPHB / SPLV, 3m)

long_duration_growth.description: Pre-profit or early-profit growth; value sits years out (spec tech, biotech, space, early AI infra)

quality_megacap.description: Cash-rich platforms with self-funded growth; rate-sensitive through the multiple only

cash_flow_value.description: Mature free-cash-flow compounders priced on yield; tolerate a rate plateau

small_caps.description: Domestic, floating-rate borrowers; first hurt by rising yields and wider spreads

banks.description: Net-interest-margin earners; like a steep curve, fear credit losses and deposit flight

homebuilders_reits.description: Rate-driven real assets; mortgage rate and MBS spread are the whole story at the margin

energy.description: Oil and gas producers and services; paid by oil up, a weaker dollar and global growth

materials_industrials.description: Global cyclicals; copper, capex and a softer dollar

defensives.description: Staples, utilities, health care; win relatively when growth scares and yields fall

em_international.description: Non-US equities; the dollar and global liquidity dominate

gold_hard_assets.description: Gold and miners; like falling real yields, a weak dollar, fiscal and geopolitical fear

crypto_high_beta.description: Bitcoin and levered beta; the purest liquidity trade

overlays: oil shock: producers over consumers of energy
hostile duration: rising real and long yields de-rate distant cash flows first
credit tail under strain: own balance sheets
mortgage rate above 7% and builders lagging
stocks and bonds falling together: Treasuries are not a hedge; use cash, T-bills, gold or options

runway_read.long_duration: headwind (fit -1.3); against: R_REAL10, R_10Y_1M, R_LONG_END; for: none
runway_read.cash_flow: neutral (fit +0.4); against: R_10Y_LEVEL, E_BREADTH_RSP; for: C_HY_LEVEL, G_CLAIMS, G_GDPNOW
runway_read.small_caps: neutral (fit -0.1); against: R_10Y_1M, E_SMALL_CAPS; for: L_NFCI, G_CLAIMS, C_HY_LEVEL

analogs.method: z-scored Euclidean distance over 9 monthly features since 1954-07; excludes the last 36 months; picks are at least 18 months apart; equity returns from the OECD US share price index (price only, monthly average)

analogs.era: Credit and housing boom, commodity super-cycle
Late-cycle expansion, QT and 2018 tightening scare, 2019 repo spike
Go-go years and Nifty Fifty; inflation starts to build, guns and butter
Post-war boom: financial repression, industrial build-out, low inflation
